# Jumia Marketplace Catalog, Seller & Deal Extractor

Jumia is not one catalogue: each country runs its own storefront, currency, promotions and seller base. This actor collects product records from the active Jumia storefronts and gives you one clean row per product, whether you start from a keyword, a category, a flash-deal page, a product URL, a seller storefront or a brand page.

It is built for price monitoring, assortment research, seller discovery and cross-market comparison. No login, cookie or API key is needed.

## Active storefronts

The actor covers the eight Jumia retail storefronts that currently serve a catalogue:

| Storefront | Domain | Currency |
|---|---|---|
| Nigeria | jumia.com.ng | NGN |
| Kenya | jumia.co.ke | KES |
| Ghana | jumia.com.gh | GHS |
| Egypt | jumia.com.eg | EGP |
| Morocco | jumia.ma | MAD |
| Senegal | jumia.sn | XOF |
| Uganda | jumia.ug | UGX |
| Côte d'Ivoire | jumia.ci | XOF |

South Africa, Cameroon and Tanzania no longer have a Jumia retail storefront: their old domains redirect to the group site or to jumia.com. Saved tasks that still send those country names get a clear status message rather than an empty run.

## Modes

- **Search by keyword** — reads the normal Jumia search listing for the chosen market.
- **Browse a category** — accepts a friendly key such as `phones-tablets`, `electronics` or `fashion`; the actor translates it to the local path (for example `telephone-tablette` on the French-language storefronts). A full category URL also works.
- **Today's flash deals** — reads `/flash-sales/`, where Jumia publishes its current time-limited offers.
- **Specific product URLs** — opens each product page and returns the full detail record. The market is detected from the URL, so a batch can mix countries.
- **Seller storefront** — reads a seller page such as `https://www.jumia.com.ng/jckm-cod/`, adds the seller's score, follower count and performance labels to every product, and supports multiple sellers in one run.
- **Brand page** — reads `/brands/<brand>/` or a category-plus-brand page, with optional keyword narrowing.

Search, category, flash, seller and brand modes share the same listing engine, filters, sort options and pagination.

## What each record contains

Every record keeps the original output fields (`productId`, `name`, `brand`, `price`, `originalPrice`, `discountRate`, `rating`, `reviewCount`, `imageUrl`, `productUrl`, `seller`, `categories`, `description`, `country`, `currency`, `recordType`, `scrapedAt`) and adds the fields Jumia exposes on its current pages.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `productId` | Product identifier taken from the product URL |
| `productIdNumeric` | Numeric product id at the end of the URL, when present |
| `sku` | Jumia config SKU, the stable key across markets |
| `name` | Product title |
| `brand` | Brand shown by Jumia |
| `price` | Current price in the market's local currency |
| `originalPrice` | Price before the current discount, when Jumia shows one |
| `discountRate` | Discount percentage |
| `rating` | Star rating, 0–5 |
| `reviewCount` | Number of ratings or reviews Jumia reports |
| `imageUrl` | Main product image |
| `imageUrls` | Gallery images when the product page exposes more than one |
| `productUrl` | Canonical product page URL |
| `seller` | Seller name, from the product page |
| `sellerId` | Jumia seller id, from a listing card or product page |
| `sellerUrl` | Seller storefront URL, when Jumia provides one |
| `sellerScore` | Seller score percentage |
| `sellerFollowers` | Follower count |
| `sellerPerformance` | Shipping speed, quality score, customer rating and cancellation rate labels |
| `categoryPath` | Category path shown on a listing card |
| `categories` | Category breadcrumb as a list |
| `category` | Leaf category, from the product breadcrumb |
| `breadcrumbs` | Breadcrumb names and URLs |
| `availability` | `InStock`, `OutOfStock` or `PreOrder` |
| `stockCount` | Units in stock when Jumia publishes a number |
| `condition` | `new`, `refurbished`, `used` or `packaging_damaged` |
| `isExpress` | Product is fulfilled through Jumia Express |
| `isOfficialStore` | Product is sold by an official brand store |
| `promotion` | Promotion or coupon label |
| `campaignBadge` | Campaign badge shown on the card |
| `position` | Position in the listing page |
| `inStock` | Stock signal from the listing card |
| `warranty` | Warranty text |
| `returnPolicy` | Return policy text |
| `returnDays` | Return window in days |
| `shippingFrom` | Lowest shipping price shown |
| `deliveryFees` | Delivery fee shown |
| `description` | Full description, product-detail records only |
| `specifications` | Key/value specification object, when Jumia exposes one |
| `shopType` | For example `Jumia Mall` |
| `gtin` | GTIN/barcode when present |
| `keyFeatures` | Bullet features |
| `inTheBox` | Pack contents |
| `topReviews` | Up to three recent reviews from the product page |
| `variants` | Simple variations with SKU, name, price, stock and selection state, when Jumia publishes them |
| `selectedVariantSku` | SKU of the selected simple variation |
| `isBuyable` | Jumia marks the product buyable |
| `reviews` | Full review rows when full reviews are enabled |
| `country` | Market TLD, for example `ng` |
| `countryName` | Readable market name |
| `currency` | ISO currency code |
| `recordType` | Always `product` |
| `scrapedAt` | UTC collection timestamp |
| `sourceUrl` | The listing or product page the row came from |

Empty values are omitted at every level. Numbers and booleans such as `0` and `false` are preserved when they are real values.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `categoryBrowse`, `flashSales`, `productDetails`, `sellerProducts` or `brandProducts`. |
| `country` | string | `nigeria` | Active storefront: `nigeria`, `kenya`, `ghana`, `egypt`, `morocco`, `senegal`, `uganda` or `cote_divoire`. The old `south_africa`, `cameroon` and `tanzania` values are accepted for saved tasks and return a clear "storefront closed" message. |
| `keyword` | string | – | Search words. The form is prefilled with `smartphone`; it also narrows brand searches when set. |
| `categorySlug` | string | – | Friendly key, local path or full category URL. Used by category and brand modes. |
| `productUrls` | array | `[]` | Product page URLs for `productDetails`. |
| `sellerUrls` | array | `[]` | Seller storefront URLs or slugs for `sellerProducts`. |
| `brand` | string | – | Brand name, slug or URL for `brandProducts`, or to narrow search/category results. |
| `sort` | string | `popularity` | `popularity`, `newest`, `lowest-price`, `highest-price` or `rating`. |
| `minPrice` | number | – | Lowest local price to keep. |
| `maxPrice` | number | – | Highest local price to keep. |
| `minRating` | number | – | Keep products rated at least this many stars (0–5). |
| `minDiscount` | integer | `0` | Keep products discounted by at least 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 or 50 percent. |
| `minSellerScore` | integer | `0` | Keep sellers in the 20, 40, 60 or 80 percent band and above. |
| `officialStoreOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep official-store products only. |
| `expressOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep Jumia Express products only. |
| `condition` | string | `any` | `any`, `new`, `refurbished` or `packaging_damaged`. |
| `enrichDetails` | boolean | `false` | Open each listing product to add description, specifications, seller score and product-page extras. |
| `partitionByPrice` | boolean | `false` | Split a large request into price bands and merge them by SKU. Runs above 1,000 items, or whose requested rows exceed `maxPages ? 40`, enable this automatically and say so in the status message. |
| `includeReviews` | boolean | `false` | Read full review pages for product-detail and enriched records. |
| `maxReviews` | integer | `20` | Reviews per product when full reviews are enabled. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `40` | Stop after this many products (up to 10,000). One listing stops at 2,000; turn on `partitionByPrice` to combine price bands. |
| `maxPages` | integer | `5` | Listing pages to read, about 40 products each. Jumia shows at most 50 pages. |

## Examples

### Search a market

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "country": "kenya",
  "keyword": "laptop",
  "sort": "lowest-price",
  "minRating": 4,
  "maxItems": 80
}
```

### Browse a category with filters

```json
{
  "mode": "categoryBrowse",
  "country": "morocco",
  "categorySlug": "phones-tablets",
  "minPrice": 1000,
  "maxPrice": 5000,
  "minDiscount": 20,
  "officialStoreOnly": true,
  "maxItems": 120
}
```

### Read a brand page

```json
{
  "mode": "brandProducts",
  "country": "nigeria",
  "brand": "samsung",
  "categorySlug": "phones-tablets",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Read a seller storefront

```json
{
  "mode": "sellerProducts",
  "country": "ghana",
  "sellerUrls": ["https://www.jumia.com.gh/his-majesty-phones-limited-ca/"],
  "enrichDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 60
}
```

### Full details for product URLs

```json
{
  "mode": "productDetails",
  "productUrls": [
    "https://www.jumia.com.ng/samsung-galaxy-a06-6.7-4gb-ram128gb-rom-android-14-black-401614264.html"
  ]
}
```

## How it works

Jumia serves its catalogue as server-rendered HTML. Listing cards carry product identity, price, discount, rating, review count, seller id, category path, position and badges. Product pages add a schema.org `Product` block with price, currency, availability, seller, barcode, specifications, rating count and reviews, plus the seller card, warranty and return policy.

Cloudflare challenges browser-shaped traffic. The actor identifies itself as a crawler and uses a matching TLS profile, which Jumia's own `robots.txt` permits at a low request rate. It requests pages one at a time with a delay, and only falls back to an Apify proxy if a direct request is blocked. There is no proxy field to configure.

## FAQ

**Do I need a proxy or cookies?**
No. The actor works without either. If Jumia blocks a direct request, the actor retries and then uses Apify's automatic proxy pool.

**Why only eight countries?**
Those are the storefronts that currently serve a Jumia catalogue. South Africa, Cameroon and Tanzania redirect away from retail. The actor reports that instead of returning an empty dataset.

**How many products can one listing return?**
Jumia caps a single listing at 50 pages of about 40 products, so 2,000 is the ceiling for one keyword, category, seller or brand. Some products repeat across pages; a 50-page slice returned about 1,970 unique products. Turn on `partitionByPrice` to collect adjacent price bands and merge them by SKU; a local 2,500-item run across two bands returned 2,500 unique products.

**What is the difference between `price` and `originalPrice`?**
`price` is what the buyer pays now. `originalPrice` is the struck-through price Jumia shows next to it. Both are in the market's currency; `currency` tells you which one.

**Why are some fields missing?**
Jumia does not publish every field for every product. Description, specifications and the image gallery come from product pages, so they appear in `productDetails` mode or when `enrichDetails` is on. Unrated products have no rating. Variants appear when Jumia publishes simple variations. Full reviews require `includeReviews`. A seller such as Jumia itself may have no storefront URL.

**Can I mix markets in one run?**
Yes in `productDetails` and `sellerProducts`, because the market is read from each URL. Keyword, category, flash and brand modes use the selected `country`.

**Are old saved tasks still supported?**
The original mode names and output fields remain. Legacy input keys are read in code, so a saved task keeps working even if its field is no longer shown on the form.

**How do I get more than 2,000 products?**
Requests above 1,000 items, or whose requested rows exceed `maxPages ? 40`, automatically use `partitionByPrice` so they finish under the 300-second run limit; you can also set it explicitly. The actor walks price bands, keeps one row per SKU, and stops at `maxItems` (up to 10,000). One listing still has its own 50-page cap.

**Can I get every review?**
Set `includeReviews` to true and choose `maxReviews`. Review pages are read in order; `topReviews` remains the three-review summary.

**Does the actor keep price history?**
No. Jumia publishes the current and struck-through price, not a history. Schedule reruns and compare `price` by `sku` over time.

**Is this affiliated with Jumia?**
No. This actor reads public Jumia pages and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Jumia.
